name: trellis
description: Local kanban boards and vaults for AI agents: board state at session start, cards with expiring claims, and a linked markdown vault.

interface.shortDescription: Local kanban boards and vaults for AI agents
interface.longDescription: Trellis gives AI coding agents a local kanban board and a linked markdown vault. Use it to claim work safely, record progress, preserve what it learns, and recover context across sessions.
defaultPrompt: Show my Trellis work and blockers.
Claim the next available Trellis card.
Save what this session verified in Trellis.
